delivery.title: Delivery & logistics
delivery.lead: Shipments, courier fees paid versus delivery fees collected from customers, and cash-on-delivery hand-over.
delivery.fees_paid_help: Counted as delivery cost in the P&L
delivery.cod_pending_help: {n} delivered shipments not handed over yet
delivery.remit_help: Record that the courier handed the collected cash to the business.
delivery.fee_collected_help: Delivery fee charged to the customer.
delivery.profit_note: Delivery cost in profit = fees paid on shipments + delivery cost typed on orders without a shipment. Collected fees are part of the order total (revenue).
delivery.empty_text: Track each delivery's courier, status and fees — or create shipments directly from orders.
